elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3 applies expressly “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: HDI must, at the Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months.

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The assistance is expressly provided “at HDI's then-current rates.”

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: HDI must return the listed Company data within 30 days of the defined “Termination Date,” which is established only through the specified termination-notice process. The clause does not establish a 30-day deadline measured from expiration or from terminations for which no Termination Date is specified.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The listed Company content and data must be returned in a “commonly used, machine-readable format,” which is a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: After the return obligation, HDI must delete the content and data and certify that deletion to the Company in writing.

elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3 applies expressly “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
elements.evidence: At the Company's request, HDI must provide assistance for a requested period of up to six months, making at least 90 days available.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The required return constitutes an export, but its deadline is tied to the defined “Termination Date,” not to every expiration or termination. Expiration and other termination scenarios may lack that defined date.
